text:
Before: 6 slices of toast, 8 butter portions, 1 muffin, and tea. After: all toast and the muffin are gone, and 4 butter portions remain, so 4 butter portions were eaten (2 tubs and 2 foil packets are visible on the plate). The mug is empty, but tea is negligible in energy.

- **Toast:** 6 slices of white bread at about 30 g each is 180 g. Toasting dries it, but per-slice energy stays about the same, roughly 80 kcal per slice, so 480 kcal.
- **Butter:** 4 portions at about 10 g each is 40 g, at roughly 72 kcal each, so 288 kcal.
- **Muffin:** about 60 g at roughly 240 kcal.

Total energy is 480 + 288 + 240 ≈ 1008 kcal. Total food mass is 180 + 40 + 60 = 280 g. Tea adds about 250 g of liquid but essentially no energy, so I counted it only in the energy estimate (as zero) and excluded it from the mass.

{"kcal": 1010, "mass_g": 280}
